baseline_construction_method.value: A log-linear, multivariate plant-level regression was fitted to an unbalanced panel of 106 plant-years from 14 plants, with production, capacity, production-mix ratios, oxygen use, scrap use, and a 2009 dummy variable as predictors.
evidence_quote: Given data on energy use and production, the parameters can be fit via a linear regression model.
In this case, production, and capacity enter the equation in log form, as does the energy variable.
The total number of “plant-years” of data included in the final analysis was 106.
the 2009 dummy variable was included in the final regression to account for the extreme impact on energy use in the recession.

Companies were asked to input actual data for all of their plants and then to determine whether the results were consistent with any energy efficiency assessments that may have been made for these plants.

proposes_treatment_mechanism.evidence_quote: The plant specific mean of the ratio of oxygen use to tons of cast slabs was computed for years where oxygen data was available and then multiplied by the reported slab production values from each year for each plant.

proposes_adaptations.evidence_quote: To correct for this, imputations were tied to the reported ratio of oxygen use to production of steel slabs.
